headline: Buyers Lift Bitcoin As Spot Delta Hits The 80.9 Percentile
narrative: Cumulative volume delta on bitcoin printed 271.369, the 80.9 percentile of the past 30 days and buy-side leaning, while bitcoin changed hands near 81k. The pipe means buyers are lifting offers in the spot market, and that is where the money is going. Exchange reserves rose 29,175.39 coins over seven days to 1,276,854.09, the 96.7 percentile of the past 30 days, so coins are still arriving on exchanges as those buyers lift the price.
author: jordan
